input: whole ultrasound image, 256 x 256 x 1 float32 in [0, 1] (proportional scaling, centred black padding); target: the expert mask with the same geometry (nearest neighbour)

random_sources.epoch_streams: numpy default_rng([seed, epoch]) for the shuffle order and for the flip decisions of every epoch (index = epoch, first epoch 0); the flip decision is indexed by IMAGE, not by position
random_sources.random_layers_in_the_network: none (no dropout; the augmentation is done on image/mask pairs outside the network)

loss.definition: per image: BCE (mean over all pixels, probabilities clipped to [1e-7, 1 - 1e-7]) + (1 - soft Dice); mean over the images of the batch; equal weights 1 : 1
loss.soft_dice: (2 * sum(p * g) + s) / (sum(p) + sum(g) + s) per image, sums over all 256 x 256 pixels, smoothing s = 1.0 (added to numerator and denominator)

augmentation.kind: joint horizontal flip of image and mask, probability 0.5 per image and epoch (one decision per image, applied to both arrays)
not_used: any transformation that treats image and mask differently

binary_threshold.status: fixed in this first attempt before the training; not tuned on validation or anywhere else

architecture.family: compact U-Net-like encoder-decoder with skip connections, trained from scratch (no pretrained weights, no additional model family, no hyperparameter search)
architecture.output_activation: sigmoid (probability of lesion pixel; not a calibrated clinical probability)
architecture.block: Conv2D 3x3 same (he_normal, no bias) -> BatchNormalization -> ReLU, twice per block
architecture.downsampling: MaxPooling2D 2x2 after each encoder block (four times: 256 -> 16)
architecture.upsampling: Conv2DTranspose 2x2 stride 2 (same), concatenation with the skip of the same level, one block per level
architecture.head: Conv2D 1x1 with sigmoid
architecture.batch_normalization: trained normally (training mode in training, moving statistics at inference); no dropout

trained_on: train; best checkpoint chosen by the validation loss (the validation expert masks steer it: not an independent assessment)
